# NadavAI

> Nadav Cohen's software house. Systems, automations, AI agents, WhatsApp bots, apps and websites for small and mid-size businesses. Free business check.
> Website: https://nadavc.ai (Hebrew at /he, English at /en)

## Who

Nadav Cohen: Mexicani franchisee running an additional branch, CTO at SporChat, Co-Founder & CTO at MediZen, and the person behind NadavAI.
Not to be confused with Prof. Nadav Cohen, the deep learning researcher at Tel Aviv University.

## Services

- Business systems and automations: Repetitive work that does itself: orders, stock, shifts, the register, reports
- AI agents and WhatsApp bots: An agent that answers your customers in Hebrew, books appointments and only passes you what matters
- Store apps: From an idea to a live app on the App Store and Google Play
- Websites and UI/UX design: A site that looks like this one, and brings in leads
- Content and scheduling system: AI that prepares, schedules and publishes your business's content
- Information security for businesses: Hardening, monitoring and testing for your business systems
- AI enablement for teams: Teaching your team to work with agents, the way I do

## Work

- MediZen (https://nadavc.ai/en/work/medizen): Clinic management, with a WhatsApp bot that books appointments.
- SporChat (https://nadavc.ai/en/work/sporchat): A live chat for every football match.
- The Green Room (https://nadavc.ai/en/work/green-room): A snooker club that runs with nobody at the desk.
- My branch (https://nadavc.ai/en/work/my-branch): The systems Nadav Cohen built for the Mexicani branch he runs: cash, Z, stock, repairs and shifts, from morning to closing.
- The Mexicani chain app (https://nadavc.ai/en/work/mexicani-network): A management system for the Mexicani chain: branches, audits, franchisee requests, tasks, finance and documents, with an AI assistant.

## Plans

Three monthly plans with service and development, and one-off projects that start with a spec. Warranty on everything.
Full technology partnership: around ₪10,000 a month

Describe your business in one sentence, and the AI shows you what to automate first. Free, no sign-up. https://nadavc.ai/en/check
